subject: general
question: Chakradhar Samaroh is organized by the Ustad Allaudin Khan Sangeet Academy and the Chakradhar Lalit Kala Kendra to commemorate the glorious memory of Maharaja Chakradhar Singh who founded the________ Gharana in music.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Raigarh__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chakradhar Samaroh **is organized by the** Ustad Allaudin Khan Sangeet Academy and the Chakradhar Lalit Kala Kendra every year on Ganesh Chaturthi in Raigarh(Chattisgarh).**
 
• **Raja Chakradhar ****the **king of Raigarh found the Raigarh Gharana of music by combining different art forms.
 
• He belonged to the **Gond dynasty** who ruled Raigarh a princely state (currently in Chattisgarh) from **(1924 to 1947).**
 
• Previously it was organized by Gond rulers but after independence, it became halted but **restarted again in 1984 by

 Sarvodaya Leader Keyur Bhushan**.
 
• It was under his chairmanship that the** "Shri Chakradhar Lalit Kala Kendra"** was established.**​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• He was a **great patron of Indian art and music**.
 
• He used to invite and make perform musicians, dancers, and other classical artists in his court.
 
• In 1938, Chakradhar Singh headed the **first All India Music Conference held at Allahabad.**
 
• **Raigarh Gharana of Kathak** was formed under his rule.
